subject: How to resolve the "400 - bad checksum" when I try to execute deployApp() function

messages.author: 6e3c4618ae21f3db
messages.subject: How to resolve the "400 - bad checksum" when I try to execute deployApp() function
parts:
I used a Mac OS machine and the latest R Studio 0.98.994

Here is the command and message

> deployApp( account = "jasonz", appName = "simple_application")
Preparing to deploy application...
Error: /v1/applications/ 400 - bad checksum


Here are a few things I have done:
1) I have run runApp() and the app works fine;
2) I have remove all the files (including those hidden ones) except for ui.R and server.R

Any idea how to address that? Thanks!

Jason
